title: Terraform against Azure: provider, state in a storage account and locking

videos.script: You met Terraform in iac. Providers, a plan, and a state file. {{iac}} Pointed at Azure, three questions come up that a laptop never asks. Whose identity does Terraform act with? {{who}} Where does the state live, so that two people and a pipeline see the same one? {{where}} And what stops two of them writing it at once? {{lock}} On Azure the answers are a sign-in chain, a blob in a storage account, and a lease on that blob. The lease you will take and break yourself, in Azurite. {{end}}
